market_summary: During the London/New York overlap, aggressive directional selling pushed equities, metals, FX, and crypto below their session Value Area Lows and VWAP baselines. However, multiple instruments (US100, XAUUSD, EURUSD, XAGUSD, BTCUSD) are now extended into or beneath their -2 ATR volatility envelopes directly testing session lows or major put walls without fresh yellow RVOL > 2.0 breakout confirmation. To avoid chasing climactic exhausts into dealer support, disciplined HOLDs are maintained across the board.

signals.rationale: Value Profile shows price_vs_value_area below_val (VAL 3879.44) and close_vs_poc below (POC 3895.14). CVD is BEARISH at -4.92 with slope -1.43, confirming selling pressure. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price is trending below downward-sloping VWAP (3896.42) and below EMA50 (3893.09). Price is pressing against the lower ATR band (3870.30) with rvol_last at 1.501, lacking yellow RVOL > 2.0 spike confirmation. Levels show a bounce off Session Low (3872.35). GEX regime is NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING with price below Gamma Flip (3883.50); however, price is directly testing Put Wall #1 at 3876.07 with Call Wall #1 overhead at 3897.91. Selling directly into Put Wall #1 with minimal scalp room to Session Low violates execution rules; HOLD is warranted.
